mapper.select: SELECT fa.player_id, p.name AS player_name, p.jersey_no, fa.team_id, t.name AS team_name, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' THEN r.stars END), 0) * 2 AS average_score, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rating_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.stars = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star1_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.stars = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star2_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.stars = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star3_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.stars = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star4_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.stars = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star5_count FROM fixture_appearance fa JOIN player p ON p.id = fa.player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = fa.team_id LEFT JOIN player_match_rating r ON r.fixture_id = fa.fixture_id AND r.player_id = fa.player_id WHERE fa.fixture_id = #{fixtureId} GROUP BY fa.player_id, p.name, p.jersey_no, fa.team_id, t.name, t.id ORDER BY t.id, p.jersey_no IS NULL, p.jersey_no, p.name

SELECT #{playerId} AS player_id, #{seasonId} AS season_id, COALESCE(AVG(r.stars), 0) * 2 AS average_score, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM player_match_rating r JOIN fixture f ON f.id = r.fixture_id WHERE r.player_id = #{playerId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND f.season_id = #{seasonId}

SELECT r.id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '微信用户') AS nickname, r.stars, r.stars * 2 AS score, r.comment, r.created_at FROM player_match_rating r JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.fixture_id = #{fixtureId} AND r.player_id = #{playerId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.comment IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
